strategy.name: mean_reversion_band
strategy.rules: Rules 1 to 5 of this file's docstring. See the docstring at the top of the script.
strategy.parameters_fixed_on: 2026-11-21 (UTC), before the first run on real data

plan_note: The eight settings were fixed before the first run. This is a sensitivity table, not a search: every row is reported and none is a recommendation.

every_first_close_outside_a_band.largest_abs_z_note: With the population standard deviation of n values, a single value can sit at most sqrt(n - 1) standard deviations from their mean: 4.3589 for n = 20.

price_when_back_at_mean_vs_entry.note: Entry is the open after the signal bar; the exit is the open after the bar that closed back at the mean. Before costs. The stop is ignored in this block.

every_first_close_outside_a_band.note: Counts on the bars. Every event is followed, including the ones the one-position rule skipped, so the windows overlap and these are not independent trades.

do_15m_returns_reverse.note: Shuffling keeps every return and destroys their order, so the range is what the statistic does when there is no dependence at all. It also destroys volatility clustering, which real returns have, so the range is narrower than a test that allowed for it would give. Read a value just outside it with that in mind.
